policies.title: Account deletion erases personal data everywhere
policies.statement: Every table carrying the personal-data tag is deleted from by the one erasure function, the function tagged erasure that a user's account deletion calls. A table left out of that function keeps a person's data after they delete their account. Anonymised rather than deleted tables are not covered by this rule: they need db.edit or db.patch added to the function's statements to be judged.

policies.title: Retained data has a cleanup task
policies.statement: Every table carrying your retained-data tag is referenced by a scheduled task that cleans it up. The task confirms a delete happens, not how old a record must be before it is deleted: the age lives in the task's own query, so a retention period (GDPR storage limitation, two years for customer data) is not checked by this rule.
